title: Australian Hangover Cure Pho with Rice Noodles
description: A bitter, creamy, and savory Australian-inspired take on traditional Vietnamese Pho, featuring high-protein rice noodles and a pasta-water emulsion to help cure hangovers.

ingredients.name: Beef Strips
ingredients.notes: Use thin strips for quick cooking.

instructions: Bring the beef bone broth to a boil in a large saucepan.
Reduce heat to a simmer and add the beef strips, cooking until browned and cooked through.
While the beef cooks, prepare the pasta water emulsion by mixing the egg yolks and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the pasta water into the bowl, whisking continuously.
Add the miso paste, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to the bowl, whisking until smooth.
Strain the beef broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a large serving bowl.
Add the rice noodles to the bowl and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the tempered egg yolk mixture to the bowl, whisking continuously to create a creamy emulsion.
Add the cooked beef strips, chopped scallions, pickled ginger, and lime juice to the bowl, mixing gently to combine.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
